body:
Founder real-time: 'read building the plane through stillness on the okemily blog' -> 'building at infinity rather' -> 'iterate.' Read the full series first (Building at Infinity, Building at Infinity: The Manuscript, Building at Infinity: Two Hundred Legions) before writing -- found 'Building the Plane Through Stillness' is a fictional book referenced INSIDE The Manuscript (its Part VII is titled 'Building at Infinity'), not a separate real post, resolving the earlier confusion. New installment, 'Building at Infinity: The Compiler That Builds Itself,' grounded in the series' established theme (non-terminating process, connective infrastructure as order) applied literally, not metaphorically, to PARENA's self-hosting milestone (S189-13/NORTHSTAR.md's new Self-hosting section) -- a compiler whose real validation is compiling itself. Published live: https://okemily.com/blog/building-at-infinity-the-compiler-that-builds-itself/ (verified 200).

⚓ ☃
title: New Building at Infinity installment published — connects the series to PARENA's self-hosting compiler
